title: the-axis-is-named-and-ruled
intention: The runtime-role axis is named explicitly and ruled — every component declares what it acts as at runtime (tool/machine/device) separately from its node_class (which gates its proof workflow).
why: child of runtime-role-is-a-second-axis: the parent's decomposition references this ticket
traces_to: Law 1 — the resolver is spent on the novel, not on re-deriving the settled; a vocabulary that forces every author to improvise a string re-derives the same question 13 times. Law 4 — the class is load-bearing physics (/sorted transcribes its gate-set into gates_bound at cast) while the improvised half is policy nothing branches on; the two should not look alike. Law 9 — a registry that no longer knows its own membership cannot answer which lots are still unexcavated.

falsifier.proves_red: RED if: (1) runtime_role is inferred from directory rather than declared; (2) runtime_role and node_class are conflated; (3) a component with no runtime_role declaration passes the census without a finding; (4) the build_inspector reads runtime_role for a structural check previously impossible.
